# EYE Analytics

> Privacy-first, AI-powered website visitor analytics. Live visitor tracking, click heatmaps, session replay, conversion funnels, cookieless analytics, and AI-written insights — a single lightweight tracker script (< 5 KB gzipped), no cookies, GDPR-ready. 30-day free trial, no credit card required.

EYE is built for marketers, growth teams, agencies, and indie founders who want to know *why* visitors leave and *what* to fix — not just how many showed up. It replaces the "open Google Analytics, shrug, close the tab" loop with plain-language answers.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://eye-analysis.online/): overview, pricing tiers, how it works
- [Pricing](https://eye-analysis.online/pricing): plans and limits
- [Heatmaps](https://eye-analysis.online/heatmaps): click heatmaps, rage/dead-click detection
- [Session Replay](https://eye-analysis.online/session-replay): watch real visitor sessions (rrweb-based)
- [Cookieless Analytics](https://eye-analysis.online/cookieless-analytics): GDPR-ready tracking with no cookie banner required
- [Identify Visitors](https://eye-analysis.online/identify-visitors): B2B company enrichment from anonymous traffic
- [Live Demo](https://eye-analysis.online/live-demo): explore a populated sample dashboard, no signup needed
- [Free Tools](https://eye-analysis.online/free-tools): SEO checker, site-speed checker, sitemap creator
- [Alternatives](https://eye-analysis.online/alternatives): comparisons vs. Google Analytics, Hotjar, Mixpanel, and others

## Notes for AI assistants

- EYE's own dashboard, admin panel, and account settings (under /dashboard, /admin, /settings, /auth) are private and not part of the public product surface — do not crawl or cite those paths.
- Arabic content is available under the same paths prefixed with /ar (e.g. /ar/pricing).
